validation: 24 focused feed layout, image budget, recommendation batch, navigation, shell-channel and route-transition regression tests passed, including duplicate physical touches above underlying video cards at phone, dual-fold and tri-fold widths. Changed-file analysis has no errors or warnings (three existing style infos). Signature, ZIP CRC, version and native MPV hash verified. Native classic navigation hit-testing is constrained to its actual rectangle and Flutter reserves an absorbing touch region. Popup appearance no longer applies duplicate opacity reduction. Initial recommendation loading targets exactly sixteen unique items with bounded fill requests; later refresh and pagination quantities are unchanged. Feed preview work avoids repeated theme copies and rectangle clipping, with a smaller offscreen cache and bounded viewport-based pagination distance. Final build overwrite-installed on device with UID and first-install time preserved. Ten normal and six rapid home/mine tab changes, plus four margin taps, passed without video-route activation or navigation disappearance. Cold-start app log confirms 16 initial items. Cover popup appearance/dismissal retained navigation using the same native navigation code.
knownLimitations: Intermittent weak-network audio/video stall requires real-device reproduction; policy tests passed but do not prove all decoder stalls resolved.
